events.name: The Song
events.intro: A tree stump. A Jigglypuff standing on it, holding a marker pen like a microphone. It's cleared its throat. It's waiting. It looks at you. It looks at the stump in front of it, where an audience would sit. It looks at you again. Nobody has ever stayed for the end of its song. You can see that it knows.

success.text: It sings. The edges of everything go soft. Everyone's asleep by the second line, and you go somewhere warm. Morning. Your face has spectacles on it. Your lead has a moustache. Somebody's been given a monocle, and suits it. The Jigglypuff is gone, and so is its audience's dignity.

effects.label: Drawn on in the night: your first Pokémon out is too embarrassed to be quick (Speed halved, next battle)

success.text: It sees. It puffs up to twice its size, turns its back on you, and leaves, stamping. The stump stays empty.

choices.label: "I'm going to stay awake this time. I promise."

success.text: Its eyes go very wide. It holds the pen out at you, as if to check you mean it, then clears its throat again.

events.name: The Song: Verse 1
events.intro: The bar drifts shut like an eyelid. A press at the right moment opens it.

success.text: Your eyes stay open. It sings on, louder, delighted.

failure.text: Your eyelids win. Morning. Your face has spectacles on it. Your lead has a moustache. Somebody's been given a monocle, and suits it. The Jigglypuff is gone, and so is its audience's dignity.

effects.label: Drawn on in the night: your first Pokémon out is too embarrassed to be quick (Speed halved, next battle)

choices.label: Your lead pinches you. (Bond 3 or more)

success.text: A sharp little pinch, right on time. You're awake. Your lead looks very pleased with itself.

events.name: The Song: The Last Note
events.intro: The last note. It opens its eyes. There's somebody still looking back.

success.text: It doesn't know what to do. Nobody's ever been there for this part. It bows. It bows again. It drops the pen, and picks it up, and holds it out. It joins you, the pen held like a sword.

effects.text: Stayed awake to the end of the Jigglypuff's song. It had never had an audience for the last line.

events.name: Dark City
events.intro: A town with every shutter down at noon. A child throws a stone at you, and is pulled indoors by an arm. The diner's owner, the only door open, Mrs. Agnes Hesketh: "They think you're one of them. Trainers. We've two gyms. Neither's real. They fight in the road over which gets to be. My window's been through four times." Outside, on cue: an Electabuzz and a Scyther, and thirty people in two colours. Yas Gym: "Free lunch. And when the inspector comes, we're official, and you're in on the ground floor." Kaz Gym: "Two free lunches." At the counter, a man in a hat is eating ketchup with a little food under it, and asking a lot of questions for a tourist.

success.text: One battle beside the Yas Gym, against the other side's Scyther. Coins from Yas. The town stays shut.
One battle beside the Kaz Gym, against the other side's Electabuzz. Coins from Kaz. The town stays shut.

choices.label: "I'll take both of you. In the road. Now."

success.text: The Electabuzz first.

choices.label: (To the man in the hat) "You're the inspector."

success.text: He takes off the hat. "A gym's for the town. A town isn't for the gym. I'll be back in a year. If the windows are mended, we'll talk. One of you. Sharing." Both signs come down by evening.

effects.text: Unmasked the gym inspector in Dark City; both signs came down by evening.

events.name: Dark City: The Scyther
events.intro: The Scyther, a little stronger, and furious that the Electabuzz went first.

success.text: The children pour ketchup on the Electabuzz, which sees red and goes after the Scyther, and that's how you learn the two Pokémon have never actually disliked each other. The feud ends: both leaders are sitting in the road, winded, looking at the broken windows as if for the first time. Mrs. Hesketh feeds the party.

win.text: Ended Dark City's gym feud in the middle of the road.

events.name: The Fossil Rush
events.intro: A canyon with two hundred people in it, all digging. Somebody's selling shovels. Somebody's selling the hole they've just dug. A digger: "Fossils! Everywhere! A man found one Tuesday! ...It was a spoon. But it was a very old spoon." On the ridge: three people and a plunger. The rival, if they're near, has spotted the fuse and is running the wrong way to stamp on it.

success.text: The blast, off-screen. The floor goes. You're in a cavern.

choices.label: Shout a warning, and dig anyway.

success.text: Half the canyon hears you and runs. The blast. The floor goes anyway, under you.

events.name: The Fossil Rush: The Cavern
events.intro: Eyes, opening, in rows. They've been shut a very long time. They're hungry in a way that's had ages to build. An Omastar, and a Kabutops, slow to start.

success.text: Slow to start: it moves like something remembering how.

effects.label: Slow to wake: the fossils start with Speed halved

events.name: The Fossil Rush: The Kabutops
events.intro: The Kabutops, unfolding.

success.text: Slow to start, then very fast.

effects.label: Slow to wake: the fossils start with Speed halved

events.name: The Fossil Rush: Wings
events.intro: Wings. A shadow the width of the cave. It takes your lead in its claws, almost gently, and it's gone up the shaft. Three turns to bring it down.

choices.label: Flying or ranged moves: bring it down.

success.text: Each hit lowers it. Two bring it down.
You climb. It's faster.

failure.text: It drops your lead, unharmed, a mile off. Your lead walks back, furious. No egg.

success.text: The Jigglypuff's on the canyon rim with its pen. One verse. The Aerodactyl lands, asleep, with your lead tucked under one wing like something it meant to keep. The Jigglypuff draws on it.

events.name: The Fossil Rush: The Rim
events.intro: Your lead, safe, and the rubble steaming.

success.text: The carried Pokémon comes back to you shaking, and won't leave your side. A fossil of your choice from the rubble, and, in the rubble, warm, a strange egg.

effects.text: Got the lead back from an Aerodactyl, and found a strange egg in the rubble.

events.name: Who Keeps the Egg
events.intro: The bag's moving. The egg's out, on the grass. A crack. Everyone in the party's round it, and everyone's trying to be the nearest without seeming to try. Your lead's elbowed somebody. Somebody's elbowed back. The rival, if they're about: "I'm just looking. I'm allowed to look." It's going to open. Whoever it sees first, that's who it's decided on.

success.text: It hatches. A Togepi. It looks up, at a very big face, and decides. The big one's ruined for anything else for a day; it keeps checking the Togepi's still there. The others sulk for one node.

effects.text: A Togepi hatched in a party Pokémon's arms, and chose it.

success.text: It hatches. A Togepi. It looks up at you. Its Bond starts at 3. The others sulk for one node.

effects.text: A Togepi hatched in your hands.

success.text: The rival: "...Why? I didn't... you found it." It's got hold of their finger. "Oh. Oh, no. All right." It's theirs. You'll see it again, on their shoulder.

effects.text: Gave the egg to the rival. It chose them.

events.name: The Bargain Day-Care
events.intro: A brand-new building. Balloons. A banner: POKÉMON BOARDING! ONE WEEK! PRACTICALLY FREE! Two very cheerful people in aprons. The Honest Trade Card's shown, and one line on it reads: "This offer is not what it says." The game doesn't lie; they do. The woman: "We love them. Don't we love them?" The man, gravelly: "We love them." The woman: "We'll make them stronger. Shinier. You won't recognise them. You literally won't."

success.text: It's safe. It's on top of the pile. It's got out of its own crate and is opening the others when you come back in, and the aprons come off. Butch and Cassidy, a double. Cassidy: "Do you know how long it takes to tie that many balloons?"

A door marked STAFF. Crates to the ceiling. Every one's got something in it, and a label for somewhere else. You have the element of surprise. Butch and Cassidy, a double. Cassidy: "Do you know how long it takes to tie that many balloons?"

effects.label: The element of surprise: Speed doubled this battle

success.text: The event ends. A stage on, you see the banner again, down, in a ditch.

events.name: The Bargain Day-Care: The Crates
events.intro: The crates are opened.

success.text: Rep and Intel. One grateful owner gives you something from her bag. The police report gets Butch's name wrong. Officer Jenny, reading it back: "'Cassidy and... Bob.'" Butch, from the van: "IT'S BUTCH!"

effects.text: Opened every crate at the Bargain Day-Care. The report said "Bob."

events.name: The Bargain Day-Care: The Van
events.intro: They leave in a van.

success.text: Your Pokémon, if you left one, is thrown out of the back of it, indignant, holding a balloon.

events.name: The Estate
events.intro: A notice on a wall, with a portrait of a small boy in a sailor suit: MISSING HEIR SOUGHT. PARENTS DECEASED. THE ESTATE AWAITS. Jessie, reading it: "That's you." James: "It isn't." Meowth: "It's got your nose. How much is an estate? ...How much is it in yen?" James: "I'm not going back there. You don't know what's in that house." They look at you. Jessie's already got James by the collar.

success.text: A kennel the size of a cottage. A house the size of a town.
They go without you. You hear about it later, from Meowth, at length.

events.name: The Estate: The Hall
events.intro: The parents are in two coffins in the hall. They sit up. His mother: "Darling! It worked. We knew you'd come for money." His father: "And now you're home, you'll marry Jessebelle." A young woman on the stairs who looks exactly like Jessie, in better clothes, with a voice like a door closing. Jessebelle: "I've waited. I'm going to make a gentleman of you. It will take years. I've set them aside." In the kennel: a Growlithe. It's old now. It's heard his voice. It's coming through the wall. James: "...Growlie? You waited?"

success.text: You hold the gate. Growlie holds the stairs. At the gate. James: "You could come." Growlie looks at him. It looks at the house. Somebody has to mind the two in the hall, daft as they are. It licks his hand, and it stays. Meowth, quietly, on the road: "Some people got a family they run from. Some of us'd take the runnin', just to have had one." A beat. "I didn't say nothin'. Yous heard nothin'." A Fire Stone, in the driveway.

effects.text: Held the gate while James ran from his own estate. Growlie stayed.

success.text: The same thing happens, a little later, through a window. At the gate. James: "You could come." Growlie looks at him. It looks at the house. Somebody has to mind the two in the hall, daft as they are. It licks his hand, and it stays. Meowth, quietly, on the road: "Some people got a family they run from. Some of us'd take the runnin', just to have had one." A beat. "I didn't say nothin'. Yous heard nothin'." A Fire Stone, in the driveway.

effects.text: Held the gate while James ran from his own estate. Growlie stayed.

events.name: The Leek Thief
events.intro: A Farfetch'd in the path, limping. A very polite boy running after it. The boy, Keith: "Oh, thank goodness. It's hurt. Would you hold this a moment? Just my bag. You're so kind." He's gone into the reeds after it. A minute. Two. The bag's heavy. It's full of rocks. Your own bag isn't on your shoulder.

success.text: He doesn't come back. Your bag's been taken. You'll get it back. For the next two nodes the road goes easy on you: nothing out there is spoiling for a fight.

effects.label: Bag taken: the next two battles are a level gentler

events.name: The Leek Thief: The Reeds
events.intro: A boat, a campfire, your bag, unopened, and four others. Keith, to the Farfetch'd, not knowing you've heard: "I'm sorry. I know you hate the limp. It's only till we've enough. Then we'll go somewhere nobody'll ask you to fight. You'd only lose, and then they'd laugh, and then they'd want to eat you. That's what they said. The last ones."

success.text: He gives it back, and doesn't look at you. He stops. It stops. The other four bags go back that night, each with a note. Everything returned, and its spare Leek.

effects.text: Found Keith in the reeds, and his Farfetch'd landed one real hit.

choices.label: "It's never won a battle, has it?"

success.text: A battle with the Farfetch'd, fought honestly. It's better than he thinks: it's been carrying that leek like a sword for years.
Everything's returned. Nothing more.

events.name: The Leek Thief: It Hit
events.intro: Whether it won or lost, it landed something real, and it stands differently after.

success.text: Keith: "...It hit yours. Did you see? It hit it. It wasn't even frightened." He stops. It stops. The other four bags go back that night, each with a note. Everything returned, and its spare Leek.

effects.text: Found Keith in the reeds, and his Farfetch'd landed one real hit.

events.name: The Hero's Visit
events.intro: A fence with twenty small faces pressed through it. The teacher, Miss Dorcas Appleby: "I promised them a trainer. I didn't have one. I thought one would turn up. One has. I'm very relieved. You're on in two minutes." A small boy at the back, arms folded, Timmy: "I don't want that one. I want Meowth. A Meowth saved me. From a Beedrill. It talked." Miss Appleby: "He says that. Meowth don't talk, Timmy."

success.text: Silence. Then all of them at once. Every Pokémon that performs: Bond +1.
Shrieking. The good kind. Every Pokémon that performs: Bond +1.
A girl sits next to it. They sit there together. It's the best one. Every Pokémon that performs: Bond +1.

events.name: The Hero's Visit: Meowth, Passing
events.intro: The trio's on the road, just past the fence.

choices.label: "There's a kid who thinks you're a hero."

success.text: Meowth: "Me? ...Nah. I never. When? ...Oh. That. I was after his sandwich. The Beedrill was in the way." You: "There's a meal in it." Meowth: "...What kinda meal?" He plays the hero, in a cape made of a tablecloth, with Jessie and James as the monster, badly. Timmy: "I said. I said it talked." Meowth, an hour later, still in the cape: "And another thing about bein' a hero..." Jessie: "We're leaving, Meowth."

effects.text: Got Meowth to play the hero for a kindergarten. He kept the cape on.

success.text: The trio walk on. Timmy watches them all the way down the road.

events.name: On Location
events.intro: Lights. Cables. A director's chair. A trailer with a star on the door, and a Wigglytuff's silhouette in the window, throwing something. The director, Mr. Cleavon Schpielbunk: "My leading lady's fired four co-stars. She slapped the fourth. I need a fifth. I need one that won't cry. Or one that will, on cue. Which have you got?"

success.text: He points. "That one. Hit the mark."
"Then get off my set." He means it kindly.

events.name: On Location: Hit the Mark
events.intro: Will it go where you point?

success.text: It goes, and stops dead on the tape.
It goes somewhere near.

events.name: On Location: Hold the Pose
events.intro: A calm or careful one holds. A hasty one fidgets, charmingly.

success.text: Still as a photograph.

failure.text: It fidgets. The crew love it. The director doesn't.

events.name: On Location: Cry on Cue
events.intro: You whisper to it. The right whisper is the thing it's actually lost, or feared, in this run.

choices.label: Whisper about the one who fainted.

success.text: It cries. Real tears. The set goes quiet.

choices.label: Whisper about the dark at the bottom of the last cave.

success.text: Its lip wobbles. Close enough.
It looks at you, puzzled, and very happy. Not a tear.

events.name: On Location: The Screen Test
events.intro: The Wigglytuff comes out for the screen test. It upstages. It steps on tails.

success.text: The director counts on his fingers.

choices.label: (A stubborn one) Step on its foot back.

success.text: The set goes silent. The Wigglytuff looks at your Pokémon for a long moment, and then, for the first time on this picture, acts.

events.name: On Location: The Verdict
events.intro: He checks the rushes twice.

success.text: Cast. Coins, and a Screen Ribbon. Fans will know it in every town for the rest of the run: shop prices are a little kinder while it leads. A fan, three towns on: "It's you! From the... I cried! My Mum cried! Can it do the face?"

effects.label: A screen star: shop prices -5% (this region)

effects.text: Cast in a film; the Screen Ribbon is pinned in the journal.

success.text: A walk-on: it's in the back of one shot, looking at the camera. And lunch.

events.name: The Stolen Badges
events.intro: A trainer on a rock, polishing eight Badges in a row, where people can see. Otoshi: "How many've you got? ...Hm. I'd all eight before I was your age. My Marowak did most of it. I mostly stood there. You'll find it's about standing correctly." The Marowak rolls its eyes. It's the only one that sees the three people in the bush.

success.text: He calls a tip after you about posture.
"There's always somebody in a bush. Bushes are popular." He goes on polishing.

events.name: The Stolen Badges: That Night
events.intro: He's at the edge of the firelight. He isn't standing correctly. Otoshi: "They took the case. I can't enter without it. I... look. I said some things. On the rock. I'd like to have not said them." The Marowak's sitting apart from him. It's ashamed of him, and it's made sure he knows.

success.text: He points, and runs. The trio, a double, beside him. Meowth's wearing all eight Badges at once. Meowth: "I'm a Champion. Look at me. I got more of these than anyone here."

"...I'm sorry. I was showing off. I've nobody to show off to, usually." The Marowak comes and stands beside him. The trio, a double, beside him. Meowth's wearing all eight Badges at once. Meowth: "I'm a Champion. Look at me. I got more of these than anyone here."

The Marowak looks at him a long time, then points its club at the bush. The trio, a double, beside him. Meowth's wearing all eight Badges at once. Meowth: "I'm a Champion. Look at me. I got more of these than anyone here."

events.name: The Stolen Badges: Properly
events.intro: He gets the case back. He battles you, as thanks, properly, and this time he calls every move himself.

success.text: Win or lose: a Thick Club, and one honest tip about the road ahead. The Badges are his, and stay his.

effects.text: Got Otoshi's Badges back, and he called every move himself.

events.name: The Buried City
events.intro: A hillside that's come away in the rain. Under it: steps, going down. An archaeologist, soaked and delighted, Dr. Eve Wainscott: "Pokémopolis. It's in one poem and no history. 'They made them great, to be their gods, and were made small.' I thought it was a figure of speech." Inside: a stone spoon as long as a room. A black bell. Two niches, empty, and on the floor between them, where the flood's rolled them together: two small relics, touching.

success.text: The roof goes.

events.name: The Buried City: They Wake
events.intro: On one side of the valley, a Gengar the height of a hill. On the other, an Alakazam, with a spoon like a bridge. They don't look down. They've an argument three thousand years old, and they've just remembered whose turn it was. They can't be beaten. They can be put to sleep.

choices.label: The relics: carry them home. (Six turns)

success.text: Your lead takes one relic; you take the other. Across the valley floor, while the fight goes on overhead.

choices.label: The Song. (The Jigglypuff, on a broken pillar)

success.text: It's never had an audience this size. One verse. They sit down, slowly, like buildings deciding to. It then draws on both of them. It takes all night.

events.name: The Buried City: Turn 1
events.intro: Falling masonry.

success.text: Through.

failure.text: They tire themselves out by dawn, and lie down where they are. The valley's a mess. No coin.

events.name: The Buried City: Turn 2
events.intro: A stray Shadow Ball the size of a house.

success.text: Through.

failure.text: They tire themselves out by dawn, and lie down where they are. The valley's a mess. No coin.

events.name: The Buried City: Turn 3
events.intro: The spoon, swinging overhead like a crane.

success.text: Through.

failure.text: They tire themselves out by dawn, and lie down where they are. The valley's a mess. No coin.

events.name: The Buried City: Turn 4
events.intro: The ground splits under the second relic.

success.text: Through.

failure.text: They tire themselves out by dawn, and lie down where they are. The valley's a mess. No coin.

events.name: The Buried City: Turn 5
events.intro: A wall, deciding.

success.text: Through.

failure.text: They tire themselves out by dawn, and lie down where they are. The valley's a mess. No coin.

events.name: The Buried City: Turn 6
events.intro: The last stretch, in the dark between two shadows.

success.text: Through.

failure.text: They tire themselves out by dawn, and lie down where they are. The valley's a mess. No coin.

events.name: The Buried City: The Niches
events.intro: Both relics, back in their niches. The two giants stop mid-swing, and lie down, and are hills again.

success.text: Quiet. Dr. Wainscott's thanks, and an ancient coin. Dr. Wainscott, either way: "Small. That's what the poem said. I'd read it as an insult. It's a relief."

events.name: The Buried City: All Night
events.intro: Two hills with moustaches.

success.text: She's been laughing in her sleep. Dr. Wainscott's thanks, and an ancient coin. Dr. Wainscott, either way: "Small. That's what the poem said. I'd read it as an insult. It's a relief."

events.name: The Buried City: The Coin
events.intro: An ancient coin: it sells very well, or the Pewter Museum will take it for a plaque with your name. A Sighting, too, for a Legendary of the region the run began in.

success.text: It sells very well.

choices.label: Leave it at the Pewter Museum.

success.text: A small brass plaque, with your name on it, under a coin.

effects.text: A plaque at the Pewter Museum, under a coin from Pokémopolis.

events.name: The Man on the Dock
events.intro: A man on the Cinnabar dock, with a boat, a pass, and all afternoon. The ferryman, Captain Jonah Tidewell: "Islands. Seven. I do three and the first. Don't ask why three. It's the fuel, or it's tradition; I've forgotten which I made up."

success.text: He's already untying the rope.
"No Gyms. No League. People who went to get away from all that, and things that live where it's quiet. You'll come back with sand in everything." He's untying the rope while he says it.
"Suit yourself. The islands'll keep."

events.name: One Island: The Network Center
events.intro: A Pokémon Center with one wall that's all machine. Cables through the window. A man asleep with his forehead on a keyboard, typing one letter for ever. The engineer, Celio: "kkkkkkk... oh. Hello. I'm linking the storage system to regions further out. So a trainer here could see a friend's Pokémon there. It nearly works. It wants two stones to tune it. A red one. A blue one. I've a drawing. I drew it at four in the morning; the proportions may be hopeful." He gives you a Tri-Pass.

success.text: "Would you? Oh. Thank you." A full rest, in the Center's back room, on a camp bed among the cables.
Celio: "My friend made the one on the mainland. Everybody uses his. I'd like to have made one thing people use." A full rest, in the Center's back room, on a camp bed among the cables.
"What day is it? ...Ah." A full rest, in the Center's back room, on a camp bed among the cables.

events.name: One Island: The Dock
events.intro: Knot Island. The Center, Mt. Ember steaming behind it, and the ferry, with Captain Tidewell asleep in it.

success.text: Up the hill, towards the steam.
Celio's awake. Just.
Captain Tidewell wakes up and taps the board.
Nothing's lost by leaving. The islands keep.

events.name: One Island: Celio
events.intro: The wall of machine, humming, half of it dark.

success.text: He fits it. Half the lights come on. He gives you one Network Machine, still warm.
Every light goes green, top to bottom, like a tide. Celio: "It's... there's somebody there. On the other end. They're waving. I don't know who they are. I'm waving." A second Network Machine.

effects.text: Turned on Celio's wall. Somebody, somewhere, waved back.

success.text: He draws it on your hand: One for the Ruby and the first half of a password, Four for the second half, Five for the warehouse. "That's three. Exactly three. I didn't plan that. I'd like to say I did." The board marks them.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Ferry Board

remembers.notice: Celio's marks are on the board: One, Four and Five. Exactly three.

events.intro: Seven islands, a level against each. "I do three. You pick." Islands the stones need are marked once Celio's been asked.

success.text: The ferry noses out. Two Island comes up out of the haze.
The ferry noses out. Three Island comes up out of the haze.

choices.label: Four Island (level A+1): the password, second half

success.text: The ferry noses out. Four Island comes up out of the haze.
He turns it over.

events.name: The Ferry Board: The Far Side
events.intro: Five, Six and Seven, and two islands in grey at the bottom.

success.text: The ferry noses out. Five Island comes up out of the haze.
The ferry noses out. Six Island comes up out of the haze.
The ferry noses out. Seven Island comes up out of the haze.
He shrugs at the grey ones.

events.name: The Ferry Board: In Grey
events.intro: Navel Rock and Birth Island, in grey. "Not without a ticket. I don't make the rules. Somebody does. Not me."

success.text: He looks at the ticket a long time, and starts the engine.
He crosses himself, which he's never done before, and starts the engine.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: Two Island: The Dock
events.intro: Boon Island. A stall, a cottage with a sign that says MOVES, and a game corner with three machines.

success.text: Along the shore.
A cottage that smells of mushrooms.
Along the shore.
Captain Tidewell's waiting with the engine running.

events.name: Three Island: The Dock
events.intro: Kin Island. One street, and a forest beyond it.

success.text: Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Captain Tidewell's waiting with the engine running.

events.name: Four Island: The Dock
events.intro: Floe Island. Cold air off a cave mouth, and an old couple on a bench.

success.text: Along the shore.
The old couple wave.
Captain Tidewell's waiting with the engine running.

events.name: Five Island: The Dock
events.intro: Chrono Island. A shed on a headland, a cave with a sign that says COUNT, and a rock offshore.

success.text: Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Captain Tidewell's waiting with the engine running.

events.name: Six Island: The Dock
events.intro: Fortune Island. A door with no handle, a field of tall grass cut into a pattern, and a plain cave.

success.text: Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Captain Tidewell's waiting with the engine running.

events.name: Seven Island: The Dock
events.intro: Quest Island. A tower with a clock, a sea cave, and a canyon.

success.text: Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Along the shore.
Captain Tidewell's waiting with the engine running.

events.name: Ember Spa and the Summit: The Spa
events.intro: A hot spring, full of old people and Slowpoke. A free rest, once. An old man: "It cures everything. I've been in since March."

success.text: Everything that hurt stops. The Slowpoke don't move up. You don't mind.
The steam follows you a little way.

events.name: Ember Spa: The Path
events.intro: Fire types on the slope. Hot ground: a burn chance for anything that isn't Fire, Rock or Ground.

success.text: Up through the heat.

failure.text: The ground bites.

success.text: Something on the slope objects.

events.name: Ember Spa: The Diggers
events.intro: Below. Grunt 1: "What's the password again? For the warehouse?" Grunt 2: "I'm not saying it. There could be people." Grunt 1: "There's nobody. It's a mountain. Is it 'Goldeen need log'?" Grunt 2: "That's the first half! You've just said the first half!" They see you. Grunt 2: "...How long have you been there."

success.text: A double battle.

events.name: Ember Spa: Still Digging
events.intro: They keep digging. The Ruby can be bought later on Two Island, expensively. You know the first half of the password anyway: they said it.

success.text: Up.

events.name: Ember Spa: The Summit
events.intro: A scorched nest, the size of a room. Empty. Warm.

success.text: A Moltres Sighting. One feather, still warm. In the tunnel the grunts opened, red light: the Ruby, if they didn't keep it.

effects.text: Stood in Moltres's nest on top of Mt. Ember.

events.name: The Growing Stall
events.intro: A stall with one item on it. It's a Berry. She's dusted it. The shopkeeper, Miss Jessamy Quoyle: "Stock's hard. The boats don't come unless there's a reason to. You could be a reason. Go and be useful somewhere, and they'll hear." Each Sevii place you finish adds a row to her shelves, and her prices never rise.

success.text: She wraps it like it's the last one. It is.

choices.label: Balls, and medicine for the road. (3 places done)

success.text: A boat came in.
Two boats came in.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Growing Stall: Balls and Medicine
events.intro: Balls, and medicine for the road (used here, out of battle).

success.text: Five, in a paper bag.
For the road: everyone patched up, here and now.

choices.label: Back to the front of the stall.

success.text: Back.

events.name: The Growing Stall: Stones
events.intro: Evolution stones. The Ruby, if you missed it. And at nine places done, TMs.

success.text: Her best one, from the box under the counter.
Expensively. She did warn you.

choices.label: TMs, and the best shop in Kanto. (9 places done)

success.text: Three boats this morning.

choices.label: Back to the front of the stall.

success.text: Back.

events.name: The Growing Stall: The Best Shop in Kanto
events.intro: At nine: TMs. At twelve: the best shop in Kanto. "Three boats this morning. Three. One of them asked for you by name. I said you were mine."

success.text: A TM that teaches whatever it can learn.
From a boat that asked for you by name.

choices.label: Back to the front of the stall.

success.text: Back.

events.name: The Move Maniac
events.intro: The Move Maniac: "I know every move every Pokémon's ever forgotten. I'll put one back. I take payment in mushrooms. I like mushrooms. Don't look at me like that." He does it by telling the Pokémon about the move, at length, until it remembers out of self-defence.

choices.label: Pay a Big Mushroom: one move it could have learned.

success.text: He talks for forty minutes. Your lead remembers, mostly so he'll stop. (A Network Machine: pick the move.)
"Then bring me one. They grow on Paras. Also in shops. Mostly on Paras."
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Missing Girl
events.intro: The island's game corner: three machines and a jukebox. A man behind the counter, wiping the same glass. The owner: "My Lostelle went over to Three for berries. She does. She's back by tea. It's past tea." He wipes the glass. "It's past tea." He doesn't ask. He can't leave the shop; there's nobody else. (Three Island goes on your Tri-Pass free: it doesn't use one of the three.)

success.text: He nods, and keeps wiping.
He stops wiping. Just for a second.
He nods back.

events.name: The Bikers
events.intro: One street. Twelve motorbikes on it. Across it, in a line, the island: fishermen, a baker, a grandmother, a boy of nine. Arms folded. No Pokémon. A biker: "We like it here. We're stopping." The grandmother: "No." A biker: "...You can't just say 'no.'" The grandmother: "I've said it."

success.text: Three battles: two bikers, then their leader.

choices.label: Show them the patch from the Bridge Run.

success.text: The leader: "Is that... that's Chopper's. You rode the bridge? In the storm? ...Lads. We're on the wrong island. Sorry about the... sorry. We'll sweep up." No fight. They leave, embarrassed. From the grandmother: a full rest at her kitchen table, for the road, and directions to the forest.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Bikers: The Second
events.intro: The second biker revs, twice, for effect.

success.text: The second.

events.name: The Bikers: The Leader
events.intro: Their leader takes off his helmet. He has very neat hair.

success.text: The leader.

events.name: The Bikers: Swept
events.intro: They go. The grandmother unfolds her arms.

success.text: "That's it," says the grandmother. From the grandmother: a full rest at her kitchen table, for the road, and directions to the forest.

events.name: Berry Forest: The Trees
events.intro: Berry trees in rows nobody planted. It's very quiet. It's the kind of quiet with something holding it. Wild Pokémon that don't attack; they watch you go by.

success.text: They watch.

events.name: Berry Forest: The Basket
events.intro: A basket on the path, tipped over. Berries in a line, leading in.

success.text: In.

events.name: Berry Forest: The Girl
events.intro: Lostelle: "I'm not lost. I know the way. I just keep not going. Every time I think 'home,' I think 'in a minute.'" Behind her, among the trunks: a pendulum, swinging. Slow.

success.text: A Hypno.

choices.label: (Stand between them, and look at it.)

success.text: Three swings. You don't follow the pendulum. It looks away first.

failure.text: The pendulum wins, for a while. When you come to, the Hypno is gone and Lostelle is holding your hand.

success.text: It's lonely. The forest's empty. She was the first thing in a year that stopped to say hello. It lowers the pendulum itself. It didn't know it was keeping her. It follows to the forest's edge, and stops, and Lostelle says: "I'll come Tuesdays." She walks home. From her father: a bundle of Nest Balls, and the stall gains two rows. Six Berries, of your choice. The owner, when she comes in, puts the glass down. He hasn't put it down all day.

effects.text: Walked Lostelle home out of Berry Forest. Her father put the glass down.

events.name: Berry Forest: Home
events.intro: The trees let you go.

success.text: Out of the trees. She walks home. From her father: a bundle of Nest Balls, and the stall gains two rows. Six Berries, of your choice. The owner, when she comes in, puts the glass down. He hasn't put it down all day.

effects.text: Walked Lostelle home out of Berry Forest. Her father put the glass down.

events.name: Icefall Cave: The Slide
events.intro: Slippery floors: a sliding puzzle. Every step carries you until something stops you.

success.text: You stop exactly at the far wall.

failure.text: You slide the long way round, twice. You get there.

events.name: Icefall Cave: The Waterfall
events.intro: A waterfall, half frozen. Behind it, a way through.

success.text: Cold, then colder.

events.name: Icefall Cave: The Ice
events.intro: Ice types: Swinub, Sneasel, Delibird.

success.text: Something with a scarf.

events.name: Icefall Cave: The Cove
events.intro: Still green water under an ice roof. Lapras, a dozen, and among them, small ones. Crates on the ledge. Four people in black, loading. In front of them: a very old woman and a Dewgong. The Dewgong's hurt. She isn't moving. Old Winter: "Fifty years I've watched this water. I watched their grandmothers hatch. You'll go through me, and I'm awkward to go through." A poacher: "She's lost three in a row. She won't sit down."

success.text: A double battle beside her. Old Winter, mid-fight: "Left one's yours. I've a grudge with the right."

events.name: Icefall Cave: The Clipboard
events.intro: The poachers leave. The second half of the password, on a dropped clipboard. A young Lapras follows you to the cave mouth.

success.text: Old Winter: "That one's nosy. Always was. Take it, if it'll go. Bring it back in the cold months. They like to come home in the cold."

effects.text: A young Lapras followed you out of Icefall Cave.

success.text: It goes back to the others, looking over its shoulder twice.

events.name: Icefall Cave: One Crate
events.intro: One crate leaves. You'll see it again in the Rocket Warehouse, where it can be opened. The clipboard's still on the ledge.

success.text: The second half of the password.

events.name: The Island Day-Care
events.intro: The old couple: "Leave us two. They'll keep each other company. We'll just be about."

success.text: They wave you off.
"They slept in a heap. We didn't like to move them. We had our tea round them." They come back a chemistry pair.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse
events.intro: A shed on a headland. A door with a speaker grille. The door: "Password."

success.text: The door: "'Goldeen need log. Yes, nah, Chansey.' ...Who wrote these? Come in."
"That's half." The grille clicks off.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: Conveyors
events.intro: Conveyor floors. Crates stencilled: VERMILION. OLIVINE. And one address that's only a number.

success.text: Round and down.

failure.text: Round, and round, and down.

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: Conveyors, Lower
events.intro: More belts. The crate from Icefall, if one left, is on one of them.

success.text: There's a list on the door.

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: The First Admin
events.intro: The first Admin, behind a desk made of crates.

choices.label: "Your Boss is beaten. Team Rocket's disbanded."

success.text: Admin: "Disbanded? Disbanded? The Boss would never. You're lying. You're... somebody would have told us." They fight harder for it.
They're a supply depot, and nervous. "You're not on the list. There's a list."

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: The Second Admin
events.intro: The second Admin, with a clipboard and a grudge.

choices.label: "Your Boss is beaten. Team Rocket's disbanded."

success.text: Admin: "Disbanded? Disbanded? The Boss would never. You're lying. You're... somebody would have told us." They fight harder for it. After: "...Nobody told us. Three months. We've been doing the inventory."
They're a supply depot, and nervous. "You're not on the list. There's a list."

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: The Scientist
events.intro: The Scientist, Dr. Ferrand: "I don't care about your Rocket or your not-Rocket. I care what this is worth. Do you know what a tuned network sells for?" In his hand: the Sapphire.

success.text: He fights like someone who's read about it.

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: The Sapphire
events.intro: The Sapphire. Intel and Heat. The crate from Icefall, if one left: you open it, and a small Lapras climbs out, very cross.

success.text: Blue, and cold, and humming faintly against the Ruby's hum.

effects.text: Took the Sapphire back from the Rocket Warehouse.

success.text: A small Lapras climbs out, very cross, and then very relieved. Old Winter will hear. You take the Sapphire too.

events.name: The Rocket Warehouse: Gone
events.intro: The Scientist leaves with the Sapphire for Six Island.

success.text: Six Island, then.

events.name: The Lost Cave
events.intro: A cave mouth. A sign that says only: "COUNT." Ghost types in the dark.

success.text: Four exits, and boulders.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Lost Cave: Room 1
events.intro: Two boulders lean together in the corner. Four exits.

success.text: Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
The air changes.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.

events.name: The Lost Cave: Room 2
events.intro: Three boulders, in a row, like they're queueing. Four exits.

success.text: Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
The air changes.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.

events.name: The Lost Cave: Room 3
events.intro: One boulder, on its own, in the middle. Four exits.

success.text: The air changes.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.

success.text: Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
The air changes.

events.name: The Lost Cave: Room 5
events.intro: Two boulders, one on top of the other. Four exits.

success.text: Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
The air changes.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.
Wrong. Something in the dark, and then the first room again.

events.name: The Lost Cave: The Last Room
events.intro: A young lady in a very good coat, sitting on a rock, bolt upright, hands in her lap. Selphy: "I'm not afraid. I came in to demonstrate that. I've demonstrated it. I'm now simply... remaining." Her knuckles are white.

success.text: "If you insist." Tea at her family's resort: a full rest. And a random valuable she insists on. Selphy: "Whatever's in my bag. I don't carry anything dull."
"I knew that." Tea at her family's resort: a full rest. And a random valuable she insists on. Selphy: "Whatever's in my bag. I don't carry anything dull."
"...Were you? Honestly? Good. Then it isn't common." Tea at her family's resort: a full rest. And a random valuable she insists on. Selphy: "Whatever's in my bag. I don't carry anything dull."

events.name: The Lost Cave: Her Bag
events.intro: At the bottom of the bag, under the valuables, a folded ticket with a lighthouse on it.

success.text: "That? A Mystic Ticket. Grandfather's. He never went. Take it; somebody should." (Navel Rock goes on the ferry board.)

failure.text: "Lint," says Selphy, firmly, and closes the bag.

events.name: The Memorial Pillar

remembers.notice: The boy: "You've left something somewhere too. I can tell. You stood right."

events.intro: A rock offshore, reached at low tide or by a Water type. A stone, with a smaller stone on it. A boy standing very straight. The boy: "It's my Onix. Tectonix. He's under here. He liked lemonade. I used to bring it. I've run out, and the shop's only got a Berry."

success.text: The boy pours a little on the stone, and drinks a little, and pours the rest. "Thank you. He's called Tectonix. I like to say it. Here. He'd want somebody to have it." He smiles. TM Metal Claw.

effects.text: Poured a drink for Tectonix at the Memorial Pillar.

success.text: The boy pours a little on the stone, and drinks a little, and pours the rest. "Thank you. He's called Tectonix. I like to say it. Here. He'd want somebody to have it." TM Metal Claw.

effects.text: Poured a drink for Tectonix at the Memorial Pillar.

success.text: "He was too big for the house. He slept round it. In a ring. You'd wake up and he'd be at every window."
"That's all right. Not many people do."

events.name: The Memorial Pillar: Tectonix
events.intro: He tells you all of it. The tide turns.

success.text: The boy pours a little on the stone, and drinks a little, and pours the rest. "Thank you. He's called Tectonix. I like to say it. Here. He'd want somebody to have it." He smiles. TM Metal Claw.

effects.text: Poured a drink for Tectonix at the Memorial Pillar.

success.text: He says the name three more times. You stay for all three.

events.name: The Dotted Hole
events.intro: A door with no handle, grown over.

success.text: The growth falls away. Steps down.

choices.label: Cut it open with a slash of anything sharp.

success.text: It takes a while. Steps down.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Dotted Hole: Floor 1
events.intro: Four holes and a sign in raised dots. The first floor teaches the alphabet: the dots say up, down, left, right.

choices.label: Read the dots and take that hole.

success.text: It said "Down." You drop through.
"Down." You drop through.

failure.text: A wrong hole. You drop back a floor, unhurt.

events.intro: Four holes and a sign in raised dots.

"Left." You drop through.

events.intro: Four holes and a sign in raised dots.

"Up." You drop through.

"Right." You drop through.

failure.text: A wrong hole. You drop back a floor, unhurt.

events.intro: Four holes and a sign in raised dots.

"Down." You drop through.

failure.text: A wrong hole. You drop back a floor, unhurt.

events.name: The Dotted Hole: The Pedestal
events.intro: The bottom. A pedestal.

success.text: As you lift it: the Scientist, coming down the last hole.
In dots. Celio can read it: "What's joined can't be owned." An Unown Sighting.

effects.text: Read the inscription at the bottom of the Dotted Hole.

events.name: Pattern Bush
events.intro: From the cliff: tall grass cut into a pattern. It's a picture of something. From inside, nobody's ever been able to tell what. A Bug Catcher at the gate: "Walk all of it, and you'll have drawn it with your feet. There's a prize. Nobody's claimed it. There's a Heracross in there that keeps moving the middle."

success.text: Into the grass.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: Pattern Bush: Bug Catcher 1
events.intro: A Bug Catcher, with a guess: "It's a Butterfree."

success.text: A short battle.

events.name: Pattern Bush: Bug Catcher 2
events.intro: A Bug Catcher, with a guess: "It's a net."

success.text: A short battle.

events.name: Pattern Bush: Bug Catcher 3
events.intro: A Bug Catcher, with a guess: "It's my mum."

success.text: A short battle.

events.name: Pattern Bush: Bug Catcher 4
events.intro: A Bug Catcher, with a guess: "It's a map of here."

success.text: A short battle.

events.name: Pattern Bush: Bug Catcher 5
events.intro: A Bug Catcher, with a guess: "It's a Heracross."

success.text: A short battle.

events.name: Pattern Bush: Bug Catcher 6
events.intro: A Bug Catcher, with a guess: "It's nothing. That's what's so good."

success.text: A short battle.

events.name: Pattern Bush: The Middle
events.intro: The whole pattern, walked. In the middle, the Heracross that keeps moving it.

success.text: From the cliff, afterwards, with your path trodden in: it's a Heracross. The sixth boy was right. He's unbearable.

effects.text: Walked the whole of Pattern Bush. It was a Heracross.

events.name: The Altering Cave
events.intro: A plain cave. A plain sign: ALTERING CAVE. Under it, in pencil: "It's never altered. — a disappointed visitor." Under that, in different pencil: "It has now." What lives in it is different in every run: something from another region entirely.

success.text: One encounter the rest of Kanto can't offer.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: Trainer Tower
events.intro: A tower. A clock on the roof, with a second hand the size of a tree. The owner, on the roof, by loudspeaker: "No items! Four ways up! The clock doesn't care which!" The times are posted on a board, this run's by your lead's name.

success.text: Single, then. The clock starts.
Double, then. The clock starts.
Knockout, then. The clock starts.
Mixed, then. The clock starts.

events.name: Trainer Tower: Walked Down
events.intro: The trainer who beat you offers an arm on the stairs.

success.text: You're walked back down, kindly, by the trainer who beat you. "Floor six gets everyone. It got me."

events.name: Trainer Tower: The Roof
events.intro: The roof, and the clock, and the owner with a stopwatch. A prize by mode, and the board.

success.text: Under the posted time. The owner hands over his own held item, different every run, and something from his coat pocket: an Aurora Ticket. "Somebody gave me it. I don't like boats." (Birth Island goes on the ferry board.)

effects.text: Beat the posted time at Trainer Tower.

failure.text: A good time, not the best. A prize by mode.

events.name: The Tanoby Chambers: The Key
events.intro: A sea cave. Seven boulders, seven marks on the floor.

success.text: When the last one's set: nothing happens here. A long way off, along the south cliffs, something does. Your lead has turned its head toward it.

failure.text: It takes all afternoon. When the last one's set, your lead turns its head toward the south cliffs.

success.text: Back along the jetty.

events.name: The Tanoby Chambers: The Seven Ruins
events.intro: Seven ruins along the south cliffs. Empty before. Not empty now. Each holds Unown, a different set of letters in each. Catch any four that spell a word, and the ruin-keeper carves you a tile.

success.text: An Unown, a letter, turning in the dark.
The ruin-keeper, Mr. Septimus Dray: "What did you spell? ...Good. That's a good one. A boy last year spelled 'SOUP.' I gave him the tile. It's a word." The word goes in your journal.

effects.text: Spelled a word in Unown at the Tanoby Chambers, and got a carved tile.

success.text: Back along the jetty.

events.name: Sevault Canyon
events.intro: A canyon with nobody in it but the best ordinary trainers in Kanto, who train here because nobody comes. The first, dropping what she's holding: "Somebody's come! Hoy! Everyone! Somebody's come!"

success.text: They're delighted. They're very good.
Back along the jetty.

events.name: Sevault Canyon: Black Belt Aldous
events.intro: The last one thanks you, sincerely, win or lose. The next one's already running over.

success.text: Thanks, sincerely, win or lose.

events.name: Sevault Canyon: Psychic Mabel
events.intro: The last one thanks you, sincerely, win or lose. The next one's already running over.

success.text: Thanks, sincerely, win or lose.

events.name: Sevault Canyon: Cooltrainer Fen
events.intro: The last one thanks you, sincerely, win or lose. The next one's already running over.

success.text: Thanks, sincerely, win or lose.

events.name: Sevault Canyon: The Dance
events.intro: From the last of them, a dance. "It's a Chansey dance. It doesn't do anything. It teaches something, if you do it for one that's never learned a gentle move."

choices.label: Dance it for one that knows no status move.

success.text: It watches, baffled, then copies, and remembers something soft: it learns Sing.

effects.text: Learned the Chansey dance in Sevault Canyon.

success.text: Everyone joins in. It doesn't do anything. It's lovely.

events.name: Navel Rock
events.intro: A rock in open sea. A stair up, and a stair down. Captain Tidewell won't get out of the boat.

success.text: At the top, wind, and a colour without a name crossing the sun. A Ho-Oh Sighting. One feather. This one lands.

effects.text: Saw Ho-Oh cross the sun from the top of Navel Rock.

success.text: At the bottom, black water, and something very large turning over in it, slowly. A Lugia Sighting.

effects.text: Saw something vast turn over in the water under Navel Rock.

events.name: Birth Island
events.intro: An empty island. One black triangle on the ground. When you step toward it, it's somewhere else. Reach it in the fewest moves, six times, each time with one move fewer.

success.text: The last time, it doesn't move. It lifts. The sky behind it's doing something. A Deoxys Sighting.

effects.text: Watched the triangle lift on Birth Island.

failure.text: It's always one step ahead. The boat's waiting.
